title: KPI
description: One measured number, referenced from strategy, process, and dashboard alike — never copy-pasted (Core Model §01). The same KPI object a leadership tile reads is the one a process rolls its performance up into (§05). LOCKED for Phase 1.

formula.description: How the value is computed, as an auditable expression or SQL-ish string. Not free prose.

direction.description: Which way is good — required so a rollup can color status without a human reinterpreting each KPI.

target.description: The value the KPI is aiming at.

live_value.description: Most recent observed value, written by the signal layer / rollup (§05, §06). null until first observation.

objective_refs.description: Objectives this KPI serves (inverse of StrategicObjective.kpi_refs).

parent_ref.description: A higher-level KPI this one rolls up to (KPI hierarchy).
